text:
Ravi (secops): PSA: Observed sidecar telemetry-sdk v2.3.x making unauthenticated requests to 169.254.169.254 from multiple staging pods. Behaviour looks like metadata harvesting when network namespace is not isolated. Marking P1 for immediate containment.

Taylor (infra): confirming, saw spikes in VPC flow logs to 169.254.169.254 around 08:12 UTC. Which clusters are hit?

Ravi (secops): Preliminary list: staging, qa, and a small subset of host-managed customer clusters that run our default monitoring daemonset. Full scan running.

Priya (platform): Kickoff: I will deploy Calico egressPolicy to block outbound 169.254.169.254 and create a DaemonSet that patches pods with hostNetwork:true. ETA ~20m.

sec-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1950 1 follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1950

Taylor (infra): For cloud-level short-term, applying VPC firewall rule to block metadata IP from non-control-plane subnets. Command (GCP):
```
gcloud compute firewall-rules create deny-metadata-egress --direction=EGRESS --priority=1000 --action=DENY --rules=tcp:80,tcp:443 --destination-ranges=169.254.169.254/32 --network=redwood-default
```
I'll limit this to staging and qa first.

Ravi (secops): Indicators:
- Pod logs: `kubectl -n monitoring logs -l app=telem -c sidecar | grep 169.254.169.254`
- Image tags: `kubectl get ds -n monitoring -o jsonpath='{..image}' | grep telemetry-sdk`
- Flow logs: filter for dst_ip=169.254.169.254

Priya (platform): Rolling patch plan: update telemetry-sidecar image to 2.4.1 (vendor patched). We'll do 10% batches, validate health, then increase. Will maintain canary in staging + one prod node.

Sam (privacy): If host-managed customer clusters are affected we may need to trigger our customer notification workflow. Tagging DPO and CS.

Maya (legal): Please gather exact customer lists before outreach. Also keep copies of any exfil traces off the ticketing system.

Taylor (infra): Quick triage note: check pods running with NET_ADMIN or hostNetwork privileges. `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.spec.hostNetwork==true) | {ns:.metadata.namespace,name:.metadata.name}'`

Ravi (secops): Immediate containment checklist:
- infra: apply VPC egress block to staging/qa within 30m (owner: Taylor)
- platform: start 2.4.1 rollout (owner: Priya)
- secops: enumerate affected pods & SA tokens, search for 169.254.169.254 hits (owner: Ravi)
- infra/secops: rotate any exposed instance/service account credentials (owner: Taylor/Ravi)
- ops: prepare drifted customer list for legal/privacy (owner: CS lead)

Taylor (infra): Applied firewall rule in qa and staging. Pushing similar to prod after we validate no downstream breakage.

Priya (platform): Patch rollout 10% -> 40% (no regressions). Watching logs for resumed metadata calls.

Ravi (secops): Found 6 pods with metadata calls in staging. Quarantined and captured logs + images into /shared/secops/INC-1950/artifacts.

Taylor (infra): Initiating credential rotation for 3 instance profiles that showed recent usage. Will coordinate with IAM team.

Sam (privacy): Notifying internal CS for possible customer impact. Waiting on final affected list.

Maya (legal): Preparing regulatory notice template in case data residency/regulator thresholds are met. Will hold until severity confirmed.

Priya (platform): Note: vendor telemetry.example.com has been contacted. Vendor claims patched 2.4.1 released yesterday. Requesting upstream CVE reference.

sec-bot: Reminder: Response SLA 1 hour. Elapsed: 22m.

Ravi (secops): Triage call scheduled in 30m. We'll publish a short incident summary in #incidents after the call and follow with a postmortem once root cause confirmed. Thanks team.
